sections.heading: Verka Jalandhar: The Doaba Union's Dairy
paragraphs: Jalandhar's main hygienic-processing plant is the Verka dairy of the Doaba Co-operative Milk Producers' Union, registered in 1972. Its milk plant opened in 1976 at a capital cost of Rs 110 lakh, handling 50,000 litres a day; it was expanded to 1 lakh litres in 1985 and to 3 lakh litres in 1991. The plant makes ghee, butter, skimmed and whole milk powder, dairy whitener, paneer and curd, and the union supplies the Defence Forces.

The union is fed by 846 village societies and three chilling centres: Sultanpur Lodhi in Kapurthala district (20,000 litres a day), Shahkot in Jalandhar district (30,000) and Khatkar Kalan in Nawanshahr district (40,000).

sections.heading: Jalandhar's Fermented Products Plant
paragraphs: In March 2023 Punjab's Chief Minister inaugurated a self-powered fermented dairy plant at Verka Jalandhar, built at a cost of Rs 84 crore to process 1.25 lakh litres of milk a day into curd and lassi. Reports on Milkfed's modernisation list it among the federation's main recent projects, alongside a Rs 325 crore plant at Mohali, Rs 123 crore at Amritsar and Rs 105 crore at Ludhiana. Milkfed's procurement grew from 18.3 lakh litres a day in 2022-23 to 21 lakh litres a day in 2024-25.

sections.heading: Lassi and Curd Lines: Where Electropolished 316L Pays Back
paragraphs: Lassi is a drinkable fermented product, often sweetened or flavoured, filled into pouches, cups or bottles and sold chilled. Its shelf life depends on keeping yeasts and moulds out after fermentation, which makes the lines from the fermentation tanks through cooling, flavour dosing and the filler the critical ones. Residue in a rough bore, a dead leg at a branch or a poorly finished weld is where those organisms survive cleaning.

For those post-fermentation lines we recommend 316L tube electropolished to SF4, with orbital welds or clamp joints and branches kept short so they drain and clean. Lactic acid and repeated acid-and-caustic CIP are the reasons to choose 316L over 304L there.

sections.heading: Chilling Centres and the Powder Plant: Where SF1 Is Enough
paragraphs: Raw-milk reception at Sultanpur Lodhi, Shahkot and Khatkar Kalan, and the evaporator and dryer side of a powder plant, do not need an electropolished bore. Mechanically polished SF1 304L tube cleans well under CIP and costs less, and we will quote it where it is the right choice. The difference matters on a co-operative budget: put the premium finish on lines that carry fermented or ready-to-drink product, not on every metre of the site.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Jalandhar Enquiry
bullets: A line list marking raw milk, heat-treated milk and fermented-product service.
OD x wall to ASTM A270 or ASME BPE dimensions and metres per size, plus bends, tees and ferrules.

Any tender documentation format; each order carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to the heat number, PMI on every length and an Ra report for each electropolished lot. Quotation within 24 hours, with delivery time confirmed in it.

sections.heading: Delivery to Jalandhar and the Doaba Region
paragraphs: Tube for Jalandhar travels by road from Mumbai, capped and sleeved; we confirm the dispatch date and transit in writing for every order.
